revisitTriggers: any Go toolchain version change (patch, minor, or major)
a new distributed target platform outside supportedTargets
a Go security release affecting the compiler, runtime, or stdlib packages linked into shipped binaries
the Go project changing its license terms or distribution channel
notes: Hashes were captured from the canonical go.dev download index (https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all) for exactly the toolchain version recorded above. These hashes are provenance pins binding this record to exact upstream artifacts; they are NOT re-verified against downloaded archives by the pipeline. What IS verified fail-closed on every run: the installed Go version matches Version, supportedTargets are covered by archive rows, and artifact URLs/filenames/hashes agree internally. Add an archive-download verification step before relying on these hashes for supply-chain verification.
